candidates.title: Weekly agent run summary

demandEvidence.chore: Summarize agent runs per agent for a team lead.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Schedule Trigger (weekly): summarize runs per agent for the team lead.

ease.reason: A sample table could support a summary mock; the discussion supplies no implementation reference.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: teams supervising agents may pay for run summaries; this single post establishes no payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week report on sample run rows is bounded, but input format and useful metrics are unspecified.

autonomy.reason: A repeatable summary could be drafted weekly; a person must supply and verify run records.

evidence.reason: The post specifies weekly per-agent summaries, but not frequency of need beyond that proposal or implementation support.

candidates.reason: Assessed a proposed weekly report from operator-supplied sample run records. Equal-weight mean 4.6 is below the threshold; no matching implementation reference is supplied.

candidates.title: Log agent runs to a sheet

demandEvidence.chore: Record agent name, task ID, status, and time when a task finishes or fails.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Every time an agent finishes or fails a task, Make should record the agent name, task ID, status and time in a Google Sheet.

ease.reason: A mock table can accept the four named fields; the supplied post offers no reference for connecting Make and Sheets.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: teams tracking agent operations may pay for setup; the request does not establish payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test with fictional completion events is narrow, but trigger and sheet integration remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: The proposed event-to-row loop is repeatable; a person must check mappings and failed writes.

evidence.reason: The request names an event and four fields, but provides no corroboration or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Assessed a proposed mock event-to-row log using fictional events and a review step. Equal-weight mean 4.8 is below threshold; no relevant implementation reference is supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: teams coordinating agent-assisted ticket work may pay for setup; no payment is shown.

candidates.reason: Assessed a proposed test-only completion notice, but the attached excerpt does not specify fields, recipient, or an actual recurring chore; equal-weight mean 4.0 is below threshold.
